topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: You want a piece of my mind? Fine. Miss that fancy shindig, did you? rugs get pulled, huh? Figures. Airlines and their schedules, all butter and no bread, leaving you high and dry. Great. Just great. You're sitting there, staring at a phone like it's gonna make the sky clearer, the plane quicker. Ain't happening. People cancel, plans change, and you’re left holding the bag. Real smooth. Slick as a fox at a henhouse. What do you do now? Rain’s coming down like the sky's got a leak, no umbrella big enough. You've got options. Sit tight, or start making calls. But you better believe, whoever was hinging on your punctuality, they're gonna have a lot of questions. And excuses don’t fly. Not when the stakes are this high.
